blocked_sentences: Station (Tap another creature you control: Put charge counters equal to its power on this Planet. Station only as a sorcery.)
12+ | {3}{W}, {T}: Create a token that's a copy of target artifact or enchantment you control, except it's legendary. Activate only as a sorcery.

needs.what: an activation cost that taps another creature you control AND binds what was tapped, so the ability's own effects can read a characteristic of it -- Station puts charge counters on the source equal to the tapped creature's power, so the number is only knowable from the permanent that paid. Concretely: an `as` (binding name) on `cost.tap_permanents`, written into `EffectContext.bindings` by `costs.pay` at the moment the creature is tapped, so `add_counters` can take `amount: {"power_of": {"binding": "stationed"}}`. The tapped creature is chosen at activation (601.2h) and must be read as it was then, so the binding also has to survive the creature leaving or shrinking before the ability resolves -- the `snapshot` treatment, but for a cost rather than a target
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `cost.tap_permanents` is the closest existing cost and it is exactly "tap another creature you control" (crew's cost, with `count`/`total_power` and `controller`/`exclude_self` from the selector language), but it is write-only: `costs.pay` (src/automtg/engine/costs.py:1205) picks the oids via `ask_objects`, calls `tap_permanent` on each, and drops them -- nothing is recorded on the ability, the state or the effect context, so no `value_keys` entry can name them afterwards. `power_of` needs an object reference and the only ones it accepts are a declared `target`, a `snapshot`, `self` or a binding some op wrote with `as`; a cost cannot be a target (crew and convoke are costs precisely because they are not targeted, and a targeted spelling would also make the creature protectable and the ability fizzle-able, which Station is not). `paid_by` is not this either: it is a trigger-filter key matched against a spell's `mana_sources_spent` (src/automtg/engine/triggers.py:1253), i.e. which lands' mana abilities paid, and it is unreachable from an ability's effects. `total_power` reads the pool's summed power but only to decide payability inside `_tap_cost_pool` (src/automtg/engine/costs.py:1011) and never yields the number to the effects. The one spelling that avoids all this -- `choose_permanents` with `as`, then the `tap` op, then `add_counters` with `power_of` the binding -- is the approximation the brief forbids: paying with an op moves the payment to resolution, so the ability could be activated with no untapped creature and could be responded to before anything tapped, and the count would be read after the window in which it could be changed.

needs.what: the "N+ |" threshold line: an ability a Planet has only while it has N or more charge counters (12+, and the same card layout also prints 4+ and 8+ tiers). It needs the threshold to gate the ability's existence, not merely its activation -- the ability should be absent from the permanent below N, so it cannot be copied, granted, or reported to the UI as an option -- and it needs a card-level spelling for the printed `12+ |` prefix so the residual gate can see one ability claiming that whole line. `Station only as a sorcery` and `Activate only as a sorcery` on the same card are already covered by `sorcery_speed_only`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The closest existing thing is `condition` on an activated ability (`activation_condition`, src/automtg/cards/loader/__init__.py:1596, checked in `legality._activation_allowed`, src/automtg/engine/legality.py:751), which can ask `counters_on` >= 12 via a `cmp`. It refuses the activation but the ability still exists on the permanent at every counter count, which is the level-up/Class distinction: below the threshold the printed ability is not there at all. Nothing in `static_effects` conditionally adds or removes an ability of the source itself -- `grant_ability` points at other objects and `lose_all_abilities` is all-or-nothing -- so there is no way to say "this permanent has this ability only while ...". Filing it here rather than shipping the `activation_condition` spelling because the Station threshold is the whole reason the mechanic exists and will be repeated on every Planet printed, so it deserves the real shape once rather than a near-miss on each card.

needs.what: `copy_permanent`'s `except_` must be able to add a **supertype** to the copy -- "except it's legendary". That means a `supertypes` key accepted by the loader's `except_` validation, stored in `Object.copy_overrides`, and unioned into `supertypes` by `characteristics.chars` alongside the existing `add_subtypes`, so the token is legendary for the legend rule and for every selector that reads `supertypes`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `except_` is validated to exactly four keys -- `colors`, `add_subtypes`, `no_mana_cost`, `types` (src/automtg/cards/loader/effects.py:1015) -- and `chars` applies only three of them (src/automtg/engine/characteristics.py:162); `supertypes` is read from the copied card and never overridden, so the token would be non-legendary and the legend rule (704.5j) would not apply, which is the entire point of the printed exception on a card whose copies are meant to be unique. Nothing else grants a supertype either: the `add_subtype` op and the `add_subtype` static both take `subtypes` only, `set_types` replaces card types, and `animate` sets types/subtypes/colors/keywords -- the supertype line is the one characteristic no effect in the DSL can touch. `create_token` is not a way around it: it names a pre-declared token id and cannot copy an arbitrary target.
